results.title: Tunnels
results.overview: A group of young people decides to organize the filming of The Date using only their own resources, while artificial intelligence takes on an increasingly important role in society.

results.title: The Next Day
results.overview: During a birthday weekend at a summer house, a group of longtime friends gather to celebrate, laugh, and relive old memories. As the night unfolds, an unexpected moment shifts the emotional balance of the group, leaving one of them silently confronting an experience he does not fully understand.

results.title: Her Song
results.overview: Olivia, a Franco-American writer, returns to her ancestral village in the south of France to write the story of her grandmother, who fled Paris during the Nazi invasion during World War II. There, she meets Madeline, a talented local artist, who quickly replaces her grandmother as the face of the novel. As a number of strange coincidences ensue, fiction and reality intermingle uncannily, and Olivia starts to ask whether she's part of history's unfolding story, or vice-versa.

results.title: The Great Experiment
results.overview: The Great Experiment is an ambitious cinematic time capsule of one of the most volatile and perplexing eras of American history; a project that serves as a historical document, non-fiction experiment and intimate observation of the changing state of American democracy and identity. A surprising time capsule of a nation grappling with its differences and diversity, and our experience and perceptions of conflict, survival and belonging.

results.title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
results.original_title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
results.overview: Go down a wormhole in this documentary on master of deadpan humor Norm Macdonald, whose life and career were uncompromising yet full of contradictions.

results.title: Doggerland
results.overview: Instead of finding a “proper” job, Alf, pushing 40, lives with his mum and drifts though Norrköping’s cultural scene. Chats & faces, routines & intuitions, local politics & everyday life – the intimate and the social, in black-and-white analogue images.

results.title: The Last Yztari
results.overview: Mary Dague lost both arms defusing bombs in Iraq. She tried for years to write her story and couldn't. Eighteen years later, she's building a world where that trauma belongs to someone else—narrated by DANI, the artificial consciousness she created to watch over her fictional selves. The film reveals her rebuilding identity through imagination, and asks what happens when the only way to tell the truth is through fiction.

results.title: Ave Mujica - prima aurora -
results.original_title: BanG Dream! Ave Mujica prima aurora
results.overview: More than half a year has passed since Ave Mujica's comeback, and spring has arrived. The band's popularity continues to grow, while each member's individual activities are also gaining momentum. The next venue Sakiko proposes is a members-only masquerade ball. What lies behind the intentions of the girl who swore to become a god...?

results.title: Crazy Kalyanam
results.overview: The story focuses on a village girl, played by Anupama Parameswaran, who faces struggles regarding her inability to get married, which drives the comedic and family-oriented plot.

results.title: Sohla
results.overview: In a small village where tradition defines destiny, young Pashya eagerly awaits his Sohla, the sacred coming-of-age ceremony. Dreaming of fame and idolizing Salman Khan, he sees it as his moment to shine. But when his father Ramdas's desperate attempt to ease the family's debts ends in tragedy, Pashya's world collapses.  Stripped of innocence, he shoulders the weight of survival with his mother and sister. As grief and duty converge on the day of the ritual, Pashya learns that Sohla is not just a spectacle, but an inheritance of resilience, sacrifice, and true manhood.

results.title: DeSu7
results.overview: After years apart, two people reunite for a fresh start. A story of deep emotion, romance, and action about love that endures and a reunion destined to happen.

results.title: The Quiet Hour
results.overview: "The Quiet Hour" is a gripping, intimate drama set over the course of one relentless night shift in an NHS hospital, where overworked nurse Riya battles exhaustion, guilt, and the ghosts of past mistakes while caring for her patients. As she juggles a collapsing system, an understaffed ward, and a stream of emergencies—from dying patients to Fred, a combative amputee, and a medical error that nearly costs a life—her professional composure begins to fracture. Haunted by the memory of a young girl she couldn’t save and the growing distance from her teenage daughter, Riya’s night spirals into a raw reckoning with compassion, burnout, and the quiet heroism that holds the health service together.

results.title: The Face
results.overview: 17-year-old Joel, a recently recruited night guard, watches over a compound marked by cartel violence. When the darkness begins to whisper, he realizes some secrets never die.

results.title: The Dollhouse
results.overview: A real estate photographer creates a 3D virtual tour, and winds up pursued by a mysterious figure, located in the scan itself.

results.title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
results.original_title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
results.overview: A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance.

results.title: Yale
results.overview: A troubled woman must confront her deadbeat father who abandoned her as a child as the last-ditch effort to find a donor kidney for her dying son.

results.title: We Wish
results.overview: Every wish has a price, especially the ones made without thinking. When two people have the same desire, accidents are sure to occur!

results.title: Wuthering Heights: The House of the Damned
results.original_title: Wuthering Heights: The House of the Damned
results.overview: Mr. Lockwood arrives at the remote and storm-battered Wuthering Heights, unaware that Catherine's vengeful ghost walks its halls. Her obsessed lover, Heathcliff, feeds her bloodlust with human sacrifice, hoping to give her soul a new body to inhabit. As Lockwood grows sick and delusional, he is drawn deeper into their deadly, undying love, and must escape before he becomes their next victim.
